title: WHEN PRAISE IS QUIET
SING OF HIS MERCIES
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: misty countryside soft golden morning light
calm lake sunrise reflection golden light
peaceful river flowing through sunlit meadow
golden light over calm countryside landscape

scenes.a: Your voice feels too quiet to praise today.
scenes.sub: WHEN YOUR VOICE FEELS TOO STILL

scenes.a: Yet God hears the gratitude lingering beneath the heavy silence in this very room.
I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
scenes.sub: I WILL SING OF HIS MERCIES

scenes.a: Father, thank You for Your endless mercy that holds us when our own strength gives out.
scenes.sub: HE HOLDS US WHEN STRENGTH FAILS

scenes.a: Even in moments of doubt, Your enduring faithfulness remains the steady anchor of our lives.
Fill our mouths with honest praise today, declaring Your grace to the next generation.
Amen. Even when your voice feels too quiet to praise today.
